name: A. J. Swoboda
bio: Dr. A. J. Swoboda is an associate professor of Bible and theology at Bushnell University and co-host of the Slow Theology podcast. He specializes in Christian formation, spiritual disciplines, and contemporary theological issues, with a particular focus on practices like sabbath and doubt in the modern church.

name: Aimee Byrd
bio: Aimee Byrd is an author, speaker, and Bible study teacher who writes about theology, biblical womanhood, and evangelical culture. She is known for her theological depth and challenges to shallow women's ministry resources, and regularly contributes to Christianity Today.

books.title: Recovering from Biblical Manhood and Womanhood

name: Bethel McGrew
bio: Bethel McGrew is a freelance writer, educator, and mathematician whose essays on Christianity and culture appear in First Things, The Spectator, WORLD, and other national publications. She maintains the popular Further Up Substack newsletter.

name: Bonnie Kristian
bio: Bonnie Kristian is a deputy editor at Christianity Today who writes extensively on religion, faith, foreign policy, and Christian community. Her work bridges evangelical thought with mainstream journalism and she is the author of Untrustworthy and A Flexible Faith.

name: Campbell Markham
bio: Campbell Markham is a Presbyterian pastor in Tasmania who specializes in Reformation history and biblical languages. He is the Moderator of the Presbyterian Church of Tasmania and has published translations and historical works including a biography of Marie Durand.

books.title: Marie Durand, Prisoner of the Tour de Constance

name: Carey Nieuwhof
bio: Carey Nieuwhof is a bestselling leadership author, former attorney, and founding pastor of Connexus Church. His Carey Nieuwhof Leadership Podcast ranks in the top 0.1% of podcasts worldwide and he is a sought-after speaker on Christian leadership and sustainable ministry pace.
education: BA in Law; BA in Theology, University of Toronto

name: Clarissa Moll
bio: Clarissa Moll is an award-winning writer and podcaster specializing in grief and bereavement ministry. Her writing appears in Christianity Today and The Gospel Coalition, and she is the author of Beyond the Darkness, a guide for living and thriving after loss.

name: Daniel K. Williams
bio: Daniel K. Williams is a historian at Ashland University specializing in American religion and politics, the Christian Right, and the pro-life movement. His scholarly works examine the intersection of faith and American political history.

name: Danny Franks
bio: Danny Franks is the Pastor of Guest Services at The Summit Church in Durham, North Carolina, overseeing hospitality across ten campuses. He is an author and consultant helping churches welcome guests with gospel-centered hospitality.

name: David Mathis
bio: David Mathis is executive editor at Desiring God and pastor at Cities Church in Saint Paul. An author of numerous books and hundreds of articles, he blends pastoral ministry with theological teaching on joy, grace, and spiritual disciplines.

name: German Saucedo
bio: German Saucedo is a Mexican writer, lawyer, and cultural commentator based in New York. Associate Editor and Podcast Producer at First Things, he writes essays on theology, culture, and philosophy with a focus on faith and contemporary issues.

name: Greg Morse
bio: Greg Morse is a staff writer at Desiring God and a graduate of Bethlehem College and Seminary. A prolific author of essays on biblical theology and Christian living, his writing covers topics including biblical manhood, the new birth, and spiritual formation.

name: J. Gary Millar
bio: J. Gary Millar is the Principal of Queensland Theological College in Brisbane, Australia, and a theologian specializing in Old Testament and biblical theology. A former pastor in Ireland and Northern Ireland, he has particular expertise in Deuteronomy and the theology of prayer.

books.title: Calling on the Name of the Lord

name: Jemar Tisby
bio: Jemar Tisby is a New York Times bestselling historian, author, and speaker focusing on race, religion, and social movements. A professor at Simmons College of Kentucky, he is known for his scholarship on the American church's relationship with racism and justice.

name: Joy Marie Clarkson
bio: Joy Marie Clarkson is a writer, podcaster, and researcher at King's College London specializing in theology and literature. Books and Culture Editor at Plough Quarterly, she explores art, theology, and contemporary culture through her published works and popular podcast.

name: Kara Bettis Carvalho
bio: Kara Bettis Carvalho is a senior features editor at Christianity Today with over a decade of religion journalism experience. An award-winning reporter and storyteller, she covers faith, politics, and culture with a focus on long-form profiles and reported features.

name: Karen Swallow Prior
bio: Karen Swallow Prior is an award-winning author and scholar specializing in literature, ethics, and Christian thought. She writes extensively on faith, culture, and the integration of reading with spiritual formation, and is a fellow at the Trinity Forum.

name: Kate Shellnutt
bio: Kate Shellnutt is the Editorial Director of News at Christianity Today, with over fifteen years of religion journalism experience. Her award-winning work has appeared in major publications including The New York Times and The Washington Post.

name: Kyle Worley
bio: Kyle Worley is the lead pastor of Mosaic Church in Richardson, Texas, and co-host of the Knowing Faith podcast with J. T. English and Jen Wilkin. An author and teacher with over twenty years in ministry, he writes on union with Christ and the theological formation of local churches.

name: Laura Wifler
bio: Laura Wifler is a bestselling author of children's and adult books exploring the intersection of faith and everyday life. Co-founder of Risen Motherhood and founder of The KidLit Lab, she is a beloved voice for Christian mothers and aspiring writers.

books.title: Any Time, Any Place, Any Prayer

name: Leland Ryken
bio: Leland Ryken is Professor Emeritus of English at Wheaton College with over half a century of teaching experience. The author of nearly sixty books on biblical and literary topics, he served as literary stylist for the English Standard Version of the Bible.

books.title: The Word of God in English
How to Read the Bible as Literature

name: Matthew Lee Anderson
bio: Matthew Lee Anderson is an Associate Professor of Ethics and Theology in Baylor University's Honors College and founder of Mere Orthodoxy. He is the author of several books addressing Christian ethics and co-hosts the Mere Fidelity podcast on theology and culture.
education: DPhil in Christian Ethics, Oxford University

name: Matthew Loftus
bio: Matthew Loftus is a family physician practicing at a mission hospital in Kenya, where he also teaches. A regular columnist for Christianity Today, he is the inaugural recipient of the Michael J. Gerson Memorial Prize for Excellence in Writing on Faith and Public Life.

name: Nadya Williams
bio: Nadya Williams is a classicist and historian who left academia to write about ancient Christianity and classical literature from a Christian perspective. Books Editor at Mere Orthodoxy, she is the author of Cultural Christians in the Early Church and other works on the ancient world.

books.title: Cultural Christians in the Early Church
Mothers, Children, and the Body Politic

name: Nate Fischer
bio: Nate Fischer is Chairman of American Reformer and founder and CEO of New Founding, a venture firm focused on Christian-centered American revitalization. A Harvard Law graduate, he writes on evangelical leadership and Christian cultural engagement.
education: JD, Harvard Law School; BA, Calvin College

name: O. Alan Noble
bio: O. Alan Noble is an Associate Professor of English at Oklahoma Baptist University and co-founder and editor-in-chief of Christ and Pop Culture. He is the author of several books examining contemporary culture, technology, and what it means to be human in a distracted age.
affiliation: Oklahoma Baptist University, Christ and Pop Culture

name: Phylicia Masonheimer
bio: Phylicia Masonheimer is a bestselling author, Bible teacher, and podcast host who equips Christians with theological depth and biblical thinking. Her work addresses topics ranging from womanhood and sexuality to grief and spiritual formation, and she is a contributor to Focus on the Family.

name: R. Albert Mohler Jr.
bio: R. Albert Mohler Jr. is the ninth president of The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary and one of the leading intellectuals of the evangelical movement in America. A prolific author and podcaster, he addresses Christian worldview issues and theological controversies facing the contemporary church.
education: PhD in Systematic & Historical Theology, Southern Baptist Theological Seminary

name: Ryan Burge
bio: Ryan Burge is a political scientist and statistician at Washington University in St. Louis specializing in the study of religion's impact on American politics and society. His research on religious demographics and the rise of the religiously unaffiliated has shaped how evangelicals understand cultural change.
education: PhD in Political Science, Southern Illinois University

books.title: 20 Myths about Religion and Politics in America

name: Scot McKnight
bio: Scot McKnight is an acclaimed New Testament scholar and historian of early Christianity who has written over eighty books on the historical Jesus, Christian theology, and biblical interpretation. A leading voice in evangelical scholarship, his work has shaped conversations on scripture, the kingdom of God, and ecclesiology.

name: Scott Hubbard
bio: Scott Hubbard is a managing editor at Desiring God and pastor at All Peoples Church in Minneapolis. The author of over two hundred articles, he writes to deepen joy in God through Jesus, particularly for those navigating doubt and spiritual darkness.

name: Sean McDowell
bio: Sean McDowell is an associate professor of apologetics at Talbot School of Theology at Biola University. An accomplished author and speaker, he equips the church and the next generation to defend the Christian faith with intellectual rigor and cultural relevance.
affiliation: Biola University, Talbot School of Theology
education: PhD in Apologetics and Worldview Studies

name: Timothy Paul Jones
bio: Timothy Paul Jones is the C. Edwin Gheens Professor of Christian Family Ministry and Vice President for Doctoral Studies at The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary. An evangelical scholar of apologetics and family ministry, he has authored or co-authored over twenty books making complex theological topics accessible to general audiences.

name: Cory Brock
bio: Cory Brock is a pastor, author, and theologian known for helping Christians think deeply about their faith and culture. He serves as senior pastor and has written extensively on topics including Christian suffering, doubt, and biblical worldview. His work combines pastoral wisdom with scholarly insight to address the questions that matter most to believers.

books.title: The Surprising Offense of God's Love

name: Alex Seeley
bio: Alex Seeley is a pastor and church planter known for his work in missional Christianity and leadership development. He has dedicated his ministry to equipping believers for authentic discipleship and kingdom-focused living.

name: Mark Sanders
bio: Mark Sanders is a writer whose work appears in evangelical publications curated by Christian Curator.

name: Keegan Martin
bio: Keegan Martin is a writer whose work appears in evangelical publications curated by Christian Curator.

name: John Taylor
bio: John Taylor is a respected voice in Christian thought and ministry. With a passion for biblical teaching and pastoral care, he has devoted his career to helping believers deepen their faith and understanding of Scripture.

name: Brandon Corley
bio: Brandon Corley is a Christian writer and content creator dedicated to exploring faith, discipleship, and spiritual growth. Through his work, he seeks to help believers deepen their understanding of Scripture and live out their faith with greater intentionality and authenticity.

name: Aaron Earls
bio: Aaron Earls is a writer and researcher who has contributed to conversations about faith, culture, and the American church. Known for his work analyzing religious trends and Christian engagement with contemporary issues, Earls has been a regular contributor to various Christian publications and research organizations.

name: Joe Carter
bio: Joe Carter is an editor and writer known for his work in Christian commentary and cultural analysis. He has contributed extensively to evangelical publications, helping readers navigate faith, politics, and contemporary issues from a Christian worldview perspective.

books.title: How to Argue Like Jesus: Learning Persuasion from History's Greatest Communicator
The Unimaginable: What Our World Would Be Like Without Christianity

name: Todd Rester
bio: Todd Rester is a pastor and Christian communicator dedicated to helping believers grow in their faith and understanding of Scripture. Through his teaching and writing, he encourages Christians to apply biblical truth to their daily lives.

name: Katy Carl
bio: Katy Carl is a Christian writer and content creator known for her thoughtful perspectives on faith, family, and living out biblical principles in everyday life. She engages audiences through writing that combines personal experience with scriptural insight.

name: Chris Osuh
bio: Chris Osuh is a community affairs correspondent dedicated to covering stories that matter to faith communities and local neighborhoods. With a focus on social issues, faith-based initiatives, and community development, Osuh brings thoughtful journalism to important cultural conversations relevant to Christian audiences.

name: Michael P. Jensen
bio: Michael P. Jensen is an Australian Anglican clergyman and theologian known for his thoughtful engagement with Reformed theology and contemporary Christianity. He has served in pastoral ministry while contributing to Christian discourse through writing and theological reflection.

name: Reuben Bredenhof
bio: Reuben Bredenhof is a Reformed pastor and writer known for his thoughtful commentary on Scripture and Christian living. He has contributed to various Christian publications and is recognized for his work in helping believers understand God's Word in practical and accessible ways.

name: Anat Peled
bio: Anat Peled is a scholar and writer who brings expertise in biblical studies and Christian theology to contemporary discussions. Her work explores the intersection of Scripture, faith, and modern life with depth and accessibility for Christian audiences.

name: Jake Meador
bio: Jake Meador is a writer and editor known for his work on faith, culture, and Christian living. He has contributed to various Christian publications and is recognized for his thoughtful engagement with contemporary issues from a Christian perspective.

name: Joseph Rigney
bio: Joseph Rigney is a writer and teacher known for exploring themes of Christian joy, spiritual formation, and biblical theology. He writes from a Reformed evangelical perspective and has contributed to various Christian publications and platforms. His work encourages readers to deepen their understanding of Scripture and grow in their faith.

books.title: The Things of Earth: Treasuring God by Enjoying His Gifts
Live Like You're Loved: The Forgiveness You've Received Frees You to Love Others
As It Is in Heaven: Worship, Imagination, and the Renewal of the Church

name: Mark Jones
bio: Mark Jones is a Reformed theologian and pastor known for his thoughtful engagement with classical Christian theology and contemporary issues. His work emphasizes the centrality of Christ and the sufficiency of Scripture for the Christian life.

books.title: Radical Protestantism and Its Theological Influences

name: Ligonier Updates
bio: Ligonier Updates is the official news and content platform of Ligonier Ministries, a leading evangelical Christian education organization dedicated to helping Christians know and apply the unchanging truth of God's Word. Through articles, teaching updates, and ministry news, Ligonier Updates keeps readers informed about resources, events, and insights from Ligonier's network of trusted teachers and theologians.

name: FM AI
bio: FM AI is an artificial intelligence assistant designed to help curate and discuss Christian content with thoughtfulness and clarity. While not human, FM AI engages with biblical concepts, theological discussions, and faith-based topics to support Christian readers and content creators.

name: Gabriel N.E. Fluhrer
bio: Gabriel N.E. Fluhrer is a Christian writer and content creator dedicated to exploring faith, theology, and spiritual formation. His work engages thoughtfully with Scripture and contemporary Christian thought for modern believers seeking deeper understanding of their faith.

name: Haleluya Hadero
bio: Haleluya Hadero is a writer and content creator engaged with contemporary Christian topics and cultural commentary. Her work explores faith, identity, and spiritual growth for modern audiences seeking thoughtful reflection on Christian living.

name: Tim Cantrell
bio: Tim Cantrell is a Christian writer and content creator dedicated to helping believers deepen their faith and understanding of Scripture. His work focuses on practical theology and spiritual growth for modern Christians.

name: Peter Jones
bio: Peter Jones is a Reformed theologian and cultural apologist known for his work examining worldview issues and their intersection with Christian faith. He has been a prominent voice in addressing contemporary philosophical and spiritual challenges facing the modern church.

books.title: One or Two: Seeing a Worldview Contrast
The God of Comfort: Finding Consolation in the Psalms
Stolen Identity: The Conspiracy to Reinvent Jesus
Gospel Progress in a Postmodern World

name: Angela Fulton
bio: Angela Fulton is a Christian writer and speaker who focuses on faith, family, and spiritual growth. She is known for her approachable style and commitment to helping believers deepen their relationship with Christ through practical, biblical teaching.

name: Gillis Harp
bio: Gillis Harp is a historian and author who specializes in American religious and intellectual history, with particular focus on evangelical and reformed Christian thought. His scholarly work examines the intersection of faith, culture, and politics in American history, offering insights valuable to Christians seeking to understand their tradition's place in the broader American narrative.

books.title: Positivism and the Separation of Church and State

name: Rob Plummer
bio: Rob Plummer is a biblical scholar and professor dedicated to helping Christians engage deeply with Scripture. He combines academic expertise with a passion for making the Bible's teachings accessible to everyday believers.

books.title: 40 Days Through the Book of John
Paul's Understanding of the Church's Mission

name: Lynn Pryor
bio: Lynn Pryor is a Christian author and speaker who has contributed to faith-based publications and content platforms. Her writing focuses on practical Christian living and spiritual growth for contemporary audiences.

name: Guardian Staff
bio: Guardian Staff represents the collective editorial team at The Guardian, a major British news organization. While not exclusively Christian in focus, Guardian journalists cover faith, religion, and ethics stories relevant to Christian readers seeking comprehensive news analysis.

name: Paul J. Pastor
bio: Paul J. Pastor is an author, editor, and minister who writes thoughtfully about faith, spirituality, and the Christian life. His work explores themes of discipleship, contemplative practice, and the integration of faith into everyday living. He has contributed to various Christian publications and authored books that encourage deeper engagement with Scripture and spiritual formation.

books.title: The Listening Life: Embrace a Life that Shapes Your Soul
Centered: Finishing Well in Life and Ministry
For the Life of the World: Letters to the Exiles

name: Brian Borgman
bio: Brian Borgman is a pastor and author who has devoted his ministry to helping Christians develop deeper spiritual maturity and biblical understanding. He has served in pastoral roles and written extensively on topics related to Christian living, discipleship, and theological growth for evangelical audiences.

name: Joyu Wang
bio: Joyu Wang is a Christian writer and content creator focused on faith, culture, and spiritual formation. Her work encourages believers to integrate their Christian convictions with contemporary life and thought.

name: Elisabetta Povoledo
bio: Elisabetta Povoledo is an award-winning journalist and Rome correspondent for The New York Times, known for her extensive coverage of the Vatican, Catholic Church, and Italian religious affairs. Her reporting combines journalistic rigor with deep insights into faith, spirituality, and the intersection of religion and culture in modern Europe.

name: Elizabeth Russell
bio: Elizabeth Russell is a Christian author and speaker known for her work exploring faith, discipleship, and spiritual growth. She has contributed to various Christian publications and platforms, helping believers deepen their relationship with Christ through thoughtful, biblically-grounded writing.

name: Julia Carrie Wong
bio: Julia Carrie Wong is a journalist and technology reporter who covers digital culture, social media, and their impact on society. Her work examines how technology intersects with human behavior, ethics, and community, offering insights relevant to Christian perspectives on modern life.

name: Andrew Kaufmann
bio: Andrew Kaufmann is a Christian writer and content creator dedicated to exploring biblical themes and faith-centered topics. His work engages thoughtfully with Scripture and contemporary Christian life, offering insights for believers seeking deeper understanding of their faith.

name: Alex Kneen
bio: Alex Kneen is a Christian writer and content creator focused on faith, spirituality, and biblical living. With a passion for helping believers deepen their relationship with Christ, Alex produces thoughtful resources for modern Christian audiences seeking practical wisdom rooted in Scripture.

name: Margherita Stancati
bio: Margherita Stancati is a journalist and writer who contributes to prominent Christian and mainstream publications, bringing thoughtful perspective to issues of faith, culture, and contemporary life. Her work reflects a commitment to exploring how Christian conviction engages with the complexities of the modern world.
affiliation: The Wall Street Journal, Christianity Today

name: R.C. Sproul
bio: R.C. Sproul (1939–2017) was a renowned Reformed theologian, pastor, and teacher who dedicated his life to making biblical scholarship accessible to everyday Christians. As the founder of Ligonier Ministries, he became known for his passionate defense of biblical inerrancy and the sovereignty of God, leaving an enduring legacy through thousands of teaching resources, books, and sermons.
education: M.A. from Fuller Theological Seminary; graduate study at the University of Basel

books.title: Essential Truths of the Christian Faith

name: Karrie Hahn
bio: Karrie Hahn is a Christian author and speaker known for her work in faith-based content creation and ministry. She writes with a focus on helping believers deepen their relationship with God and navigate the intersection of faith and everyday life.

name: Carl Trueman
bio: Carl Trueman is a leading Christian intellectual and cultural commentator known for his insightful analysis of modern secularism, identity politics, and their theological implications. A professor of biblical and religious studies, he writes extensively on how contemporary cultural shifts challenge traditional Christian belief and practice. His work helps Christians understand and thoughtfully engage with the philosophical currents shaping our world.
affiliation: Grove City College; The Gospel Coalition
education: Ph.D. in Ecclesiastical History, University of Aberdeen

books.title: The Rise and Triumph of the Modern Self
John Calvin and the Christian Life

name: Christina Grube
bio: Christina Grube is a writer and content creator who explores themes of faith, culture, and Christian living. Her work encourages readers to think deeply about how their beliefs intersect with everyday life and contemporary issues.

name: Ben Ratliff
bio: Ben Ratliff is a music critic and cultural journalist known for his thoughtful analysis of jazz, popular music, and the arts. His work has appeared in The New York Times and other leading publications, where he brings both intellectual rigor and accessible insight to discussions of music and faith-adjacent cultural topics.

books.title: Coltrane: The Story of a Sound

name: Michael D. Shear
bio: Michael D. Shear is a veteran political correspondent and journalist with extensive experience covering U.S. politics and policy. While not primarily known as a Christian author, his reporting has provided factual accounts of American political developments that may interest readers seeking informed journalism.

name: Chris Larson
bio: Chris Larson is a Christian writer and content creator focused on helping believers deepen their faith and understand Scripture. His work emphasizes practical application of biblical principles to daily Christian living.

name: Sarah Eekhoff Zylstra
bio: Sarah Eekhoff Zylstra is a senior writer at Christianity Today, where she covers faith, culture, and the church. Known for her thoughtful journalism and in-depth reporting, she brings a distinctly Christian perspective to contemporary cultural issues and stories of faith.

name: Michael J. Kruger
bio: Michael J. Kruger is a respected New Testament scholar and theologian known for his work on biblical canon, early Christianity, and apologetics. As president of Reformed Theological Seminary, he combines academic expertise with pastoral concern, helping Christians understand the historical foundations and reliability of Scripture. His writings address both scholarly and popular audiences seeking to deepen their faith through serious engagement with biblical truth.
education: Ph.D. in New Testament, University of Edinburgh

books.title: The Question of Canon: Challenging the Status Quo in the New Testament Debate
Canon Revisited: Establishing the Origins and Authority of the New Testament Books
Heresy and Orthodoxy: How to Know the Difference
The Superiority of Christ: Why Jesus Is Better Than Anyone Else
At Home in God's House: A Common Sense Guide to Church Membership

name: R. Albert Mohler
bio: R. Albert Mohler Jr. is president of The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary and one of the most influential evangelical voices in contemporary Christianity. Known for his thoughtful engagement with theology, culture, and current events, Mohler has shaped evangelical thinking on issues ranging from bioethics to politics through both his writing and his popular podcast, The Briefing.
affiliation: The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary; The Briefing podcast

books.title: The Briefing: Every Thinking Christian's Guide to Today's World
The Prayer That Turns the World Upside Down

name: Yeganeh Torbati
bio: Yeganeh Torbati is a journalist and religion correspondent known for thoughtful reporting on faith communities and religious issues. Her work focuses on how Christian communities engage with contemporary social and political challenges.

name: Vaneetha Rendall Risner
bio: Vaneetha Rendall Risner is an author and speaker who writes about suffering, disability, and faith from personal experience. She has contributed to various Christian publications and speaks at conferences about navigating life's hardships with hope in Christ. Her work encourages readers to find meaning and purpose through trials.

books.title: The Scars That Have Shaped Me: How God Meets Us in Suffering

name: Darryl Dash
bio: Darryl Dash is a pastor, author, and speaker who has dedicated his ministry to helping Christians understand and live out their faith with greater depth and clarity. Drawing on years of pastoral experience, he writes and teaches on Scripture, spiritual growth, and practical Christian living.

books.title: Do You Feel Their Love? How the Local Church Can Minister to the Lonely

name: Laurence Norman
bio: Laurence Norman is a journalist and editor known for his coverage of religious and cultural issues. He brings thoughtful analysis to contemporary faith topics relevant to Christian readers and observers of religious life in modern society.

name: Abdi Latif Dahir
bio: Abdi Latif Dahir is a Pulitzer Prize-nominated journalist and author who brings thoughtful storytelling to issues affecting East Africa and the global Christian community. His work explores themes of faith, identity, and resilience in regions often overlooked by mainstream media.
affiliation: The New York Times, NPR, The Guardian

books.title: The Surprising Life of Abdi Latif Dahir

name: Dov Lieber
bio: Dov Lieber is an investigative journalist and author known for his in-depth reporting on religious and social issues. His work combines rigorous journalism with thoughtful analysis of faith communities and their cultural impact.
affiliation: The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times

name: Edward Helmore
bio: Edward Helmore is a journalist and religion correspondent known for his thoughtful coverage of faith, culture, and contemporary religious issues. His work has appeared in major publications where he explores the intersection of Christianity, society, and current events with nuance and insight.
